subject: Request: temporary inflight headroom credit + priority lanes for Skyline campaign
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@skyline.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@skyline.ai
Date: 2026-07-11T15:02:00Z
Subject: Unexpected holiday campaign — temporary headroom & priority lane request

Hi Rishi / Lauren,

We're seeing a ~3x spike in inference volume starting tomorrow 08:00 PDT driven by an unplanned marketing push. Our current Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs, committed throughput) is healthy but the burst reserve won't fully cover the predicted peak. We tried autoscale but the workload is latency-sensitive (chat flows for end-users) and queueing is already showing tail latency risk.

Can Redwood approve a short-term inflight headroom credit and route a small proportion of our requests (5-10%) into a higher-priority lane to protect p95/p99 for sessions? Specific ask: 72 hours of priority lane gating with an explicit throughput carve (additional 120 tokens/sec sustained across our pool) and a corresponding credit to offset overage. We can provide the traffic profile and logs.

Attached: capacity_report_June2026.pdf (shows baseline + projected delta).

Urgency: high — campaign launches 2026-07-12 08:00 PDT. Let me know what you need from our side.

Thanks,
Emma Torres
Head of Platform Integrations, Skyline AI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Torres <emma@skyline.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-11T17:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected holiday campaign — temporary headroom & priority lane request

Emma — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. I reviewed the report quickly: the projected spike is substantial but not impossible to accommodate. Quick thoughts and immediate options we can offer: 

1) Priority lane (soft carve): we can route up to 10% of requests from your tenant into a higher-priority queue with token-burst tokens applied. This will reduce queueing at p95/p99 for those sessions while still protecting overall pool fairness.

2) Short-term inflight headroom credit: we can apply a consumption credit for the event window (pro-rated overage) pending CS/billing review. Lauren, can you confirm a preliminary credit limit we can approve without exec sign-off?

3) Immediate config change: Ben, can you surface the expected impact on overall tail latency if we carve 120 tokens/sec? Also, what's the rollback plan if we see contention?

If Skyline can commit to the campaign start time, we'll aim to push the config change 2 hours before to validate. Also please send the per-minute TPS profile and a sample trace for a failed p99 so our runtime team can validate cache/KV behavior.

I'll draft an SLA addendum stub and share it for signatures once billing confirms credit.

- Rishi
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Emma Torres <emma@skyline.ai>
Date: 2026-07-11T18:24:00Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected holiday campaign — temporary headroom & priority lane request

Quick technical readout:

- Carving 120 tokens/sec dedicated to Skyline as a priority lane is feasible on their current reserved pool. It equates to roughly ~2 GPUs equivalent for their avg model mix during peak. The headroom will come from burst tokens and transient re-balancing of batch sizes.
- Risk: if another tenant has a simultaneous burst that exceeds our cross-tenant burst cap, we could observe backpressure at queue admission; we mitigate this with token backoff and dynamic batch-scaling.
- Rollback plan: automated rollback if p95 latency for non-priority tenants degrades >20% relative to baseline for 5 consecutive minutes. We can tie in an emergency preemption flag that drops Skyline priority if system-wide SLOs are at risk.

Operational steps (proposed timeline):
- 06:00 PDT day 0: dry-run with controlled traffic (we'll mirror 10% of Skyline traffic to priority lane).
- 07:00 PDT: enable priority lane (gradual ramp 25% -> 100% of the carved throughput).
- 09:00 PDT: monitoring check-in and decide whether to maintain or roll back.

I'll prepare a small playbook snippet for the day-of ops runbook. Priyom, please prepare the throttling thresholds and the rollback automation.

— Ben
Senior Technical Program Manager, Dedicated Runtime
From: Emma Torres <emma@skyline.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@skyline.ai
Date: 2026-07-11T19:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected holiday campaign — temporary headroom & priority lane request

This sounds good and appreciated — Skyline accepts the proposed carve + rollback safeguards. We will: 
- Share the per-minute TPS profile and one sample p99 trace within 30 minutes.
- Confirm campaign start window (08:00 PDT) and send the production config toggle that our engineers will use to flip on/off client-side features.

Regarding credits: procurement flagged that a provisional credit up to $6k would be sufficient for the event. If legal needs a signed addendum we can fast-track it. Please attach the draft SLA addendum to the thread.

Thanks — Emma
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Torres <emma@skyline.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@skyline.ai
Date: 2026-07-12T22:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected holiday campaign — temporary headroom & priority lane request

Emma — sending confirmation and next steps. Attachments: draft_sla_addendum_v1.docx (contains the 72-hour carve, numerical carve details, rollback triggers, and provisional credit clause). Billing and Legal have been looped: Lauren, can CS approve a provisional $6k credit pending DocuSign? Lauren: please confirm and I'll route to finance.

Operational plan summary (final):
- 06:00 PDT 2026-07-12: dry-run to validate mirroring and monitoring dashboards.
- 07:00 PDT: staged enable of priority lane up to the 120 tokens/sec carve.
- Real-time alerts for p95/p99 for both Skyline and system-wide tenants, automated rollback if non-priority p95 worsens >20% for 5m.
- Post-mortem and consumption reconciliation by 2026-07-15 23:59 PDT.

Emma — thank you for the quick turnaround. Please upload the TPS profile to HS-84829 or reply-all with the file. We'll prepare DocuSign after Lauren confirms the credit.

Regards,
Rishi
[Attachments referenced in thread: capacity_report_June2026.pdf (pdf), draft_sla_addendum_v1.docx (docx)]
